- 2026-11-10 (architect, I-127; Brian queued it, Nov 10, 2026): contract and step files, no code. ARCHITECTURE §B12 gains Retries and partial writes. Script: right after the PDF is created it caches `pdf:<id>` (send epoch ms, 21,600 s), and a retry with that `id` writes only the JSON, named with the PDF's sent stamp, so (a) PDF written then a JSON throw gives one pair after the retry; (b) a lost reply retried inside 6 h hits `done:<id>` → `ok`, no Drive call, nothing counted; (c) after an expired or evicted marker the retry files a second copy. Chosen over accepting the duplicate because the marker is one cache write (no Drive read, no delete, no banned API) and its eviction only falls back to that duplicate. Accepted result: two copies of one send with the same marks; Brian keeps the later pair and deletes the rest (runbook part 6). Once both files exist the reply is `ok` (a later throw logs `bodymap: state-error`). Page: the `id` is a v4 UUID from `crypto.getRandomValues` (`randomUUID` is secure-context only; LAN preview is http), stored in the 24 h entry, kept across retries and reloads, dropped on `ok`, Start over or any edit, so an edit is never swallowed by `done:<id>`; Storage gains `id`. B2 test 13 (sequences a, b, c) and the part 6 runbook line; B4 test 2. - 2026-11-05 (I-054, not applied; decision I-055 for Brian): measured on `astro preview`, Lighthouse 13.5 mobile. `fetchpriority="low"` has no effect on an SVG `<image>` (Chrome keeps it Medium; `/book` 96, LCP 2.71 s either way). With no terrain request at all, `/book` is 100, LCP 1.51–1.66 s; zone pages are 97–98 (LCP 2.4–2.6 s) with it. A lazy `<img loading="lazy" fetchpriority="low">` in a `<foreignObject>` gets the same gain without JS and is identical in Chromium, but in WebKit (Safari's engine) the shading stops short of the map's left edge at the full view, so it was dropped. Re-encoding the WebP saves only 20–35%. The workable way left is JS (set `href` when the map shows or after load), which leaves JS-off visitors without terrain and adds a script to the zone pages: a §B4/§D change for Brian to decide.
